Slave address when A0 pin is high

register_map.notes: Pointer register selects data register; two LSBs of pointer byte select register.

read_channels.notes: 12-bit two's complement temperature data in 16-bit register; lower 4 bits zero.

access_model.notes: Pointer register must be written before reading a different register; repeated reads from same register do not require rewriting pointer.

transaction.notes: Write pointer value byte to select a data register.

steps.notes: Pointer byte: two LSBs select register (00=Temp, 01=Config, 10=TLOW, 11=THIGH).

operation_flows.notes: Used to set pointer for subsequent read/write.

preconditions: Pointer register must point to Temperature Register (0x00).

transaction.notes: Write pointer value 0x00 to select Temperature Register.

steps.notes: Wait for conversion to complete; 220ms for 12-bit resolution (max 300ms). For lower resolutions, shorter delay may be used.

transaction.notes: Read two bytes (MSB first) from Temperature Register.

steps.notes: Byte1: T11-T4; Byte2: T3-T0 (upper nibble) with lower nibble zero.

outputs.notes: Raw 16-bit value; lower 4 bits are zero.

operation_flows.notes: If pointer already points to Temperature Register, the initial write can be omitted. Delay ensures conversion complete for first read after power-up or reset.

transaction.notes: Write pointer value 0x01 to select Configuration Register.
Write one data byte to Configuration Register.

steps.notes: Byte format: OS, R1, R0, F1, F0, POL, TM, SD.

transaction.notes: Write pointer value 0x03 to select THIGH Register.
Write two data bytes MSB first (byte1: H11-H4, byte2: H3-H0 with zeros in lower nibble).
Write pointer value 0x02 to select TLOW Register.
Write two data bytes MSB first (byte1: L11-L4, byte2: L3-L0 with zeros in lower nibble).

preconditions: Device must be in shutdown mode (SD=1).

transaction.notes: Write pointer 0x01 then configuration byte with OS=1 (and SD=1) to start one-shot conversion.

steps.notes: OS bit is self-clearing; reads as 0.
Wait for conversion time (220ms for 12-bit resolution; adjust for lower resolutions).

transaction.notes: Write pointer 0x00 to select Temperature Register.
Read two bytes (MSB first) from Temperature Register.

steps.notes: Byte1: T11-T4; Byte2: T3-T0 (upper nibble) with lower nibble zero.

operation_flows.notes: After one-shot, device returns to shutdown. Temperature is read via explicit read steps.

transaction.notes: Send General Call address 0x00 with R/W=0, then second byte 0x06 to reset.

steps.notes: Resets internal registers to power-up values and latches address pin.
Small delay to allow reset to complete.

preconditions: Device must be in Interrupt Mode (TM=1) and ALERT pin active.

transaction.notes: Master sends Alert Response address 0x19 (00011001) with R/W=0; if ALERT active, device acknowledges and returns its slave address with direction bit.

steps.notes: The returned byte includes slave address (7 bits) and direction bit (LSB) indicating THIGH (1) or TLOW (0) condition.

operation_flows.notes: If multiple devices respond, arbitration determines which clears its ALERT.

raw_encoding.notes: Temperature register: 2 bytes MSB first; lower 4 bits are zero. 12-bit two's complement value in bits 15:4.

registers_or_commands.name: Pointer Register
registers_or_commands.description: 8-bit register used to address data registers; two LSBs select register.

registers_or_commands.name: Temperature Register
registers_or_commands.description: 12-bit read-only register storing most recent conversion output; two bytes MSB first.

registers_or_commands.name: Configuration Register
registers_or_commands.description: 8-bit read/write register controlling operational modes; power-up/reset value all bits 0.

registers_or_commands.name: TLOW Register
registers_or_commands.description: 12-bit low temperature limit register; two bytes MSB first; LSBs zero.

registers_or_commands.name: THIGH Register
registers_or_commands.description: 12-bit high temperature limit register; two bytes MSB first; LSBs zero.

bitfields.name: P1-P0
bitfields.description: Selects which data register is accessed: 00=Temperature, 01=Configuration, 10=TLOW, 11=THIGH.

bitfields.name: OS
bitfields.description: One-Shot: write 1 to start single conversion in shutdown mode; reads as 0.

bitfields.name: F1-F0
bitfields.description: Fault queue: number of consecutive faults to trigger alert; 00=1, 01=2, 10=4, 11=6.

bitfields.name: T11-T0
bitfields.description: 12-bit temperature data in two's complement format; bits 3:0 are zero.

bitfields.name: H11-H0
bitfields.description: 12-bit high limit value; bits 3:0 are zero.

bitfields.name: L11-L0
bitfields.description: 12-bit low limit value; bits 3:0 are zero.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up/reset: Configuration Register all bits 0 (continuous conversion, 9-bit resolution, 1 fault, active low ALERT, comparator mode). Pointer register P1/P0 = 00 (Temperature Register selected).
Wait for first conversion to complete: 27.5ms (9-bit) to 220ms (12-bit) depending on default resolution (9-bit).

read_sequence.notes: Write pointer 0x00 to select Temperature Register, then read 2 bytes (MSB first).

timing_constraints.name: scl_frequency
timing_constraints.notes: SCL operating frequency up to 400 kHz.

timing_constraints.name: timeout_time
timing_constraints.notes: Timeout time for SCL or SDA held LOW.

conversion_formulae.name: temp_conversion
conversion_formulae.formula: Temperature (°C) = raw_12bit * 0.0625, where raw_12bit is the 12-bit two's complement value from the Temperature Register (bits 15:4).
conversion_formulae.notes: Canonicalized: exact compensation is preserved in formula/inputs, but the single-line integer expression was marked non-executable because it is too complex or not accepted by the safe expression evaluator.

error_conditions.condition: I2C NACK during address or data transfer
error_conditions.detection: Slave does not acknowledge; SDA remains HIGH during ACK clock pulse.

error_conditions.driver_action: Release bus and wait for START condition; retry communication.

power_states.name: shutdown
power_states.notes: Low power shutdown; serial interface active.

evidence_spans.snippet: The 8-bit Pointer Register of the devices is used to address a given data register.
Table 2. Pointer Addresses of the TMP105
The Temperature Register of the TMP105 is a 12-bit, read-only register
byte 1 is the most significant byte; byte 2 is the least significant byte
The Configuration Register is an 8-bit read/write register
The power-up/reset value of the Configuration Register is all bits equal to 0.
Shutdown Mode is enabled when the SD bit is 1
writing a '1' to the OS bit starts a single temperature conversion

The TMP105 operates only as a slave device on the Two-Wire bus and SMBus.
Accessing a particular register on the TMP105 is accomplished by writing the appropriate value to the Pointer Register.
If repeated reads from the same register are desired, it is not necessary to continually send the Pointer Register byte
The first byte transmitted by the master is the slave address, with the R/W bit LOW.
The TMP105 supports the SMBus Alert function.
The TMP105 responds to a Two-Wire General Call address (0000000) if the eighth bit is 0.

requires_human: Confirm that the temperature conversion formula is raw * 0.0625 for 12-bit resolution; for lower resolutions, LSBs are zero so formula still applies.
Verify that the pointer register is written before every read if the pointer needs to be changed; repeated reads from same register do not require rewriting pointer.
Check that the ALERT pin polarity and mode (comparator/interrupt) are configured as needed for the application.
